purpose: Identity record of the published orbss/ansible-lint@1.0.0 source. It is the comparison baseline for the unchanged default executor and execute command. The contract is docs/python-install-contract.md.

value_sources: Redmine project 319 Wiki 110_ロードマップ version 1, design principle 1
expected.note: The injection and publication packs of the v1.0.0 tag pipeline had the same packed SHA-256 (#5503 journal 11186).

stored_copy.content: The exact registry source bytes. No normalization, reformatting, or added newline.

retrieval.source: CircleCI orb registry: the source of orbss/ansible-lint@1.0.0
retrieval.method: CircleCI MCP server tool get_orb_source with orb reference orbss/ansible-lint@1.0.0. The JSON response was saved to a file, and its source string was decoded and written as UTF-8 bytes without other changes.
retrieval.verification: The stored copy's size and SHA-256 equal the expected values.
not_used: repacking src/ with any CLI version
retrieval.reproduction: Any retrieval method is acceptable when the resulting bytes have the expected size and SHA-256. Tools that print a source can add or remove a trailing newline, so verify before use.

ci_reference.applies_to: 1.1.0 release candidates, which must not differ from this baseline (contract section 5.4). Later releases use the previous published version as the baseline, with adopted expected differences (contract section 5.6).
ci_reference.rule: Read stored_copy.path from the checked-out candidate commit. Verify its size and SHA-256 against expected before every parse or comparison. A missing, unreadable, or mismatching file fails the check. Never replace the file or the expected values automatically.
